format.Talking head / UGC: A person talks to camera (clinician, founder, creator, staff).
format.Patient testimonial: A real patient or customer tells their story.
format.Practice walkthrough / B-roll: Tour, drone, behind-the-scenes or montage footage without a main speaker.
format.Motion graphic / animated text: Video built from animated text, graphics or product renders.
format.Lifestyle photo static: Single image led by a photo of a person or setting.
format.Product photo static: Single image led by a product shot (ecommerce).
format.Typographic / infographic static: Single image led by text, price, list or comparison graphic.
format.Organic / partnership post: Boosted organic or creator partnership post.

angle.Anxiety / nervous: Fear of the dentist, gentle care, calm.
angle.Confidence / appearance: Hiding smile, photos, how you look.
angle.Function / comfort: Eating, speaking, pain, slipping dentures, getting the machine working.
angle.Convenience / speed: One visit, fast, fits your life, easy booking, delivery.
angle.Expertise / trust: Credentials, specialists, reviews, technology, years established.
angle.Local / community: Names the town, local practice, family-run.
angle.Life event / timing: Wedding, birthday, new job, season, back to school, Christmas.
angle.Craft / quality: Materials, durability, finish, how it's made.
angle.Transformation / aspiration: Dream smile, finished room, the result itself.

offer.Priced exam / check-up / intro offer: e.g. new patient exam £75, £29 for 3 classes.
offer.Monthly finance: Monthly price or 0% finance is the lead offer.
offer.Bonus extras: Free whitening, free retainers, free scan worth £X.
offer.No offer: Brand or soft sell with no offer.

persona: Short noun phrase for who the ad speaks to, normalised to one of: Nervous patient, Lapsed patient, New to area, Busy professional, Parent, Teen / child (via parent), Denture wearer, Missing teeth, Cosmetic-conscious adult, Bride / life-event, Medical card holder, Fan / gift buyer, Collector, Tradesperson, Site manager / buyer, DIY homeowner, Interior enthusiast, Fitness beginner, Dental practice owner, General / broad.
